mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 60 degrees and an air quality index of 61. The overnight low will reach 54 degrees and there is no rain forecasted for tonight.
The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth, and the city continues to maintain a strong Moody's Aa1 financial rating.

We have a full slate of activities including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow, and the Puppets in the House community day at Century School Park tomorrow.
On October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested by police after he was found in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy today's flavor of the day, OREO Cookie Overload, before they close their doors at 10:30 PM tonight.
